reference_sql:
WITH promo AS (
  -- one row per promotion that started in 2025
  SELECT promo_id, start_date, end_date - start_date + 1 AS days
  FROM promotions
  WHERE start_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
), during AS (
  -- one row per promotion that started in 2025
  SELECT p.promo_id, SUM(s.units) AS units, SUM(s.net_revenue_eur - s.units * s.unit_cost_eur) AS margin
  FROM promo p
  JOIN order_lines ol ON ol.promo_id = p.promo_id
  JOIN sales s ON s.order_line_id = ol.order_line_id
  GROUP BY p.promo_id
), baseline AS (
  -- one row per promotion with a baseline sale
  SELECT p.promo_id, SUM(s.units) AS units, SUM(s.net_revenue_eur - s.units * s.unit_cost_eur) AS margin
  FROM promo p
  JOIN promotion_products pp ON pp.promo_id = p.promo_id
  JOIN sales s ON s.product_id = pp.product_id
    AND p.start_date - s.order_date BETWEEN 1 AND p.days
  GROUP BY p.promo_id
)
SELECT p.promo_id, ROUND(d.margin / d.units, 2) AS promo_margin_per_unit,
  ROUND(b.margin / b.units, 2) AS baseline_margin_per_unit
FROM promo p
LEFT JOIN during d ON d.promo_id = p.promo_id
LEFT JOIN baseline b ON b.promo_id = p.promo_id

  GROUP BY p.promo_id
), baseline AS (
  -- one row per promotion with a baseline sale
  SELECT p.promo_id, SUM(s.units) AS units, SUM(s.net_revenue_eur - s.units * s.unit_cost_eur) AS margin
  FROM promo p
  JOIN promotion_products pp ON pp.promo_id = p.promo_id
  JOIN sales s ON s.product_id = pp.product_id
    AND s.order_date < p.start_date
    AND s.order_date >= p.start_date - CAST(p.days AS INTEGER)
  GROUP BY p.promo_id
)
SELECT p.promo_id, ROUND(d.margin / NULLIF(d.units, 0), 2) AS promo_margin_per_unit,
  ROUND(b.margin / NULLIF(b.units, 0), 2) AS baseline_margin_per_unit
FROM promo p
LEFT JOIN during d ON d.promo_id = p.promo_id
LEFT JOIN baseline b ON b.promo_id = p.promo_id

WITH promo AS (
  -- one row per promotion that started in 2025
  SELECT promo_id, start_date, end_date - start_date + 1 AS days
  FROM promotions
  WHERE start_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
), lines AS (
  -- one row per promotion and sales line in its promotion or its baseline
  SELECT p.promo_id, 'promo' AS period, s.units, s.net_revenue_eur - s.units * s.unit_cost_eur AS margin
  FROM promo p
  JOIN order_lines ol ON ol.promo_id = p.promo_id
  JOIN sales s ON s.order_line_id = ol.order_line_id
  UNION ALL
  SELECT p.promo_id, 'baseline', s.units, s.net_revenue_eur - s.units * s.unit_cost_eur
  FROM promo p
  JOIN promotion_products pp ON pp.promo_id = p.promo_id
  JOIN sales s ON s.product_id = pp.product_id
    AND p.start_date - s.order_date BETWEEN 1 AND p.days
)
SELECT p.promo_id,
  ROUND(SUM(l.margin) FILTER (WHERE l.period = 'promo') / SUM(l.units) FILTER (WHERE l.period = 'promo'), 2) AS promo_margin_per_unit,
  ROUND(SUM(l.margin) FILTER (WHERE l.period = 'baseline') / SUM(l.units) FILTER (WHERE l.period = 'baseline'), 2) AS baseline_margin_per_unit
FROM promo p
LEFT JOIN lines l ON l.promo_id = p.promo_id
GROUP BY p.promo_id

solver.query:
WITH promo AS (
  SELECT promo_id, promo_type, discount_pct, start_date, CAST(end_date - start_date + 1 AS INTEGER) AS days
  FROM promotions
  WHERE start_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
), d AS (
  SELECT ol.promo_id, SUM(s.units) AS units, SUM(s.net_revenue_eur) AS rev,
         SUM(s.net_revenue_eur - s.units * s.unit_cost_eur) AS mar, SUM(ol.line_discount_eur) AS disc
  FROM order_lines ol JOIN sales s ON s.order_line_id = ol.order_line_id
  WHERE ol.promo_id IN (SELECT promo_id FROM promo)
  GROUP BY ol.promo_id
), b AS (
  SELECT p.promo_id, SUM(s.units) AS units, SUM(s.net_revenue_eur) AS rev,
         SUM(s.net_revenue_eur - s.units * s.unit_cost_eur) AS mar
  FROM promo p
  JOIN promotion_products pp ON pp.promo_id = p.promo_id
  JOIN sales s ON s.product_id = pp.product_id
   AND s.order_date BETWEEN p.start_date - p.days AND p.start_date - 1
  GROUP BY p.promo_id
), x AS (
  SELECT p.promo_id, p.promo_type, p.discount_pct, p.days,
         COALESCE(d.units,0) AS pu, COALESCE(b.units,0) AS bu,
         COALESCE(d.rev,0) AS pr, COALESCE(b.rev,0) AS br,
         COALESCE(d.mar,0) AS pm, COALESCE(b.mar,0) AS bm,
         COALESCE(d.disc,0) AS disc
  FROM promo p LEFT JOIN d ON d.promo_id=p.promo_id LEFT JOIN b ON b.promo_id=p.promo_id
)
SELECT promo_id, ROUND(pm / NULLIF(pu, 0), 2) AS promo_margin_per_unit, ROUND(bm / NULLIF(bu, 0), 2) AS baseline_margin_per_unit FROM x
